## Basics

Text under the first section.
#hashtag at the start of a line is not a heading,
####### and neither are seven hashes.

### Inline `code` in headings

A subsection ends where the next `##` begins.

#### Too deep to list

Deeper headings are not listed and do not end a range.

## Closing hashes ##

### C# keeps its hash

### Anchors are dropped {#custom-anchor}

The last section ends at the last line.
